name: Lip Sync Battle
description: Each episode features two A-list celebrities like you've never seen them before - syncing their hearts out in hysterically epic performances. Hosted by LL Cool J with colorful commentary by social media maven and supermodel co-host, Chrissy Teigen. The mic is off, the battle is on!

videos.title: Holiday Special
videos.overview: The Night Before co-stars Seth Rogen, Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Anthony Mackie go head-to-head.

videos.title: Live Special
videos.overview: Michael Phelps & special guests join LSB All-Stars John Legend, Terry Crews, & Olivia Munn in this unprecedented television event.

videos.title: Lip Sync Battle Shorties
videos.overview: Actress Sarah Hyland hosts a special group of regular children as the lip sync some of their favorite songs and honor their favorite musicians.

videos.title: Zendaya vs. Tom Holland
videos.overview: It’s Peter Parker vs. Michelle as the stars of “Spider-Man: Homecoming” duke it out in the LSB arena.  Special episode for the 2017 MTV Movie & TV Awards.

videos.title: Hip Hop Special
videos.overview: Lip Sync Battle celebrates Hip Hop's biggest night in this one hour BET Hip Hop Awards Special featuring a four-way battle between Remy Ma, T-Pain, Jay Pharoah and Anika Noni Rose.

videos.title: Lip Sync Battle LIVE: A Michael Jackson Celebration
videos.overview: The one-hour special features larger-than-life performances by Taraji P. Henson, Neil Patrick Harris, Hailee Steinfeld and Laverne Cox LIVE from the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles. Also featuring a special performance by Michael Jackson ONE™ by Cirque du Soleil.

videos.title: Soul Train Special
videos.overview: BET - Soul Train Awards 2017. Tank, Keyshia Cole, Loni Love, and Macy Gray.

videos.overview: The host of The Tonight Show Jimmy Fallon gets in the ring with professional actor, producer and wrestler Dwayne Johnson.

videos.overview: Each took home an Oscar, but who will snag coveted honor of the Lip Sync Battle Champion? Soul singer John Legend and hip hop star Common go from collaborators to competitors in this epic battle.
